turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
Over the past two months I’ve had increasing generalized fatigue and severe itching all over. I also have yellowing in my eyes and plenty of scratch marks on my trunk and arms/legs.
[ASK] Do you have **skin rash with blistering/skin peeling** (e.g., Stevens-Johnson–type)?
“No, I haven’t had blistering or skin peeling—just intense itching with multiple scratch marks on my trunk and arms/legs.”
[ASK] Does the patient have **COPD-like symptoms** (e.g., chronic cough with sputum and persistent shortness of breath, often with smoking history)?

“No, I don’t have a chronic cough or sputum, and I’m not short of breath. It’s mainly the increasing fatigue and intense, generalized itching, with the yellowing in my eyes and scratch marks on my trunk and arms/legs.”
[ASK] Do you have **severe wheezing/shortness of breath triggered by allergens or exercise**?

“No, I don’t get wheezing or shortness of breath with exercise or allergens—this has been mainly the worsening fatigue and intense generalized itching, plus the yellowing in my eyes and the scratch marks on my trunk and arms/legs.”
[ASK] Do you have **involuntary movements or progressive neurologic decline** (e.g., tremor, chorea, or worsening coordination)?

“No, I haven’t had any involuntary movements, tremor, or worsening coordination—no neurologic decline that I’ve noticed. My main issues have been the worsening fatigue, severe generalized itching, yellowing in my eyes, and the scratch marks on my trunk and arms/legs.”
[ASK] Do you have **fever and a productive cough** (or shortness of breath) suggesting a **lung infection**?

“No—I haven’t had fever, cough, or any shortness of breath. It’s been mainly the worsening generalized fatigue and severe generalized itching, with yellowing in my eyes and lots of scratch marks on my trunk and arms/legs.”
[ASK] Have you had **unexplained bleeding or easy bruising** (e.g., frequent nosebleeds, gum bleeding, large bruises, or prolonged bleeding after minor cuts)?
“No, I haven’t noticed any unusual bleeding or easy bruising—no nosebleeds, gum bleeding, or big bruises, and cuts haven’t bled longer than usual.”
[ASK] Have you had **unintentional weight loss, night sweats, or fevers** (B symptoms) recently?

“No, I haven’t had any fevers, night sweats, or unintentional weight loss—just the two months of worsening fatigue, severe generalized itching, yellowing in my eyes, and the scratch marks on my trunk and arms/legs.”

[ASK] Does the patient have psychiatric symptoms consistent with a schizophrenia-spectrum disorder (e.g., delusions/hallucinations or prominent disorganized thinking) rather than a purely mood disorder?

“No, I don’t have hallucinations, delusions, or disorganized thinking—my main concerns are the worsening fatigue, intense generalized itching, yellowing in my eyes, and the scratch marks on my trunk and arms/legs.”

“No, I’m not aware of anything like that—I don’t have specific symptoms tied to erythropoietin, but I’ve been feeling increasingly fatigued and intensely itchy for the last two months, with yellowing in my eyes and lots of scratch marks on my trunk and arms/legs.”
